description:
This gripping episode chronicles history's most indestructible explorers, from Shackleton's legendary Antarctic rescue mission to Mawson's horrific solo trek across the ice. Discover how Freuchen escaped an icy tomb using frozen excrement, Nansen's audacious drift towards the North Pole, and Cabeza de Vaca's remarkable decade-long survival among hostile American tribes.
